    • plan

      IActionPlan<R> plan()
      Runs target resolution and precondition evaluation without any backend side effect and returns an immutable, inspectable IActionPlan.

      Unlike execute() and dryRun(), calling plan() never advances the action: it only produces a snapshot. The plan can later be inspected or executed with IActionPlan.execute(), which always revalidates resolution and preconditions before any backend action, so a stale plan can never cause the wrong element to be acted on; that revalidated execution shares the plan's IActionPlan.actionId(), so a result can always be correlated back to the plan that produced it.

      dryRun() and plan() are mutually exclusive terminal modes on the same prepared action: dryRun().execute() validates and returns an ActionResult without ever producing a plan, while plan() always produces a plan whose execute() performs the real action regardless of any earlier dryRun() call. Calling plan() after dryRun() on the same prepared action throws IllegalStateException rather than silently picking one interpretation.

      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if dryRun() was already called on this prepared action

    • policy

      default IPreparedAction<R> policy(IActionPolicy policy)
      Configures an IActionPolicy that must ALLOW this action before its backend side effect is invoked - by execute() directly, by dryRun()'s validation, and by the real execution behind IActionPlan.execute() alike. A DENY, a thrown exception, or any other evaluation failure prevents the backend from ever being called; see docs/governed-execution.md for the exact pipeline position and failure shape.

      The default implementation always throws UnsupportedOperationException - only an IPreparedAction implementation that actually enforces this configuration may override it; a caller must never be able to configure a policy that is silently ignored.

      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if policy is null
      IllegalStateException - if a policy is already configured on this prepared action

    • networkPolicy

      default IPreparedAction<R> networkPolicy(INetworkPolicy networkPolicy)
      Configures an INetworkPolicy that must ALLOW this action's network destination - checked before the backend call, and, for a NAVIGATE action, checked again after navigation against the final URL, since a browser's own internal redirects cannot be intercepted mid-flight. Only ActionType.NAVIGATE has a network destination known before its backend call is made; configuring this on any other action type is rejected immediately rather than silently ignored, since the framework cannot honestly enforce a network policy it cannot actually evaluate before that action's backend call.

      The default implementation always throws UnsupportedOperationException for the same reason policy(IActionPolicy)'s does.

      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if networkPolicy is null
      IllegalStateException - if a network policy is already configured on this prepared action
      UnsupportedOperationException - if this action is not a NAVIGATE action (thrown by an enforcing implementation; the inherited default throws it unconditionally)
